q: Two minimal topological dynamical systems are orbit-equivalent iff:
opts: Their orbit groupoids are isomorphic as étale groupoids
They have the same number of periodic orbits
exp: The orbit groupoid G(X,f) = {(x,n,y): fⁿ(x)=y} captures the orbit structure. Two minimal systems are orbit-equivalent (same orbit structure up to homeomorphism) iff G(X,f) ≅ G(Y,g) as groupoids. This is the Giordano–Putnam–Skau characterisation.
